Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 153. Category: stance. Stances.

Prerequisites: dexterity 15+, Wisdom 13+
A fighting style made to use fast deadly strikes.
As an action you may make a single melee attack at
advantage.
+1 Static Bonus to all attack rolls and saving throws
for barrage attacks
You gain a +1 to your natural AC
